description: This file defines the PointNode class, which models a point with x, y coordinates and an optional angle for PCB layout processing. It extends PcbNode and provides methods for coordinate translation, connection checking, and representation.

classes.name: PointNode
classes.description: Represents a point in PCB layout with optional rotation angle and various utility methods.

methods.name: PointNode(String nodeName, int i, List<Object> children)
methods.description: Constructs PointNode from a list of children objects, parsing coordinates and optional angle.

methods.name: PointNode(double x, double y)
methods.description: Constructs PointNode with specified x and y, defaults angle to 0.

methods.name: PointNode(double x, double y, double angle)
methods.description: Constructs PointNode with x, y, and angle.

methods.name: isConnected(PointNode at, SizeNode size)
methods.description: Checks if this node is connected to another based on size dimensions.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of PointNode.

methods.name: translate(PointNode at)
methods.description: Translates this point considering its angle relative to another point.

methods.name: setLocation(double x, double y)
methods.description: Sets the location of the point by updating children list elements.
